verdict.rationale: Firebase documents a Local Emulator Suite that runs Cloud Firestore, Realtime Database, Cloud Storage, Authentication, Hosting, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub and Extensions locally. Apps can connect to it for integration testing or QA without touching production data, and the official CLI also runs a local Hosting server and supports unit tests via the Test SDK. missing for 10: Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub and Extensions emulation is only beta, no evidence that every Firebase product is emulated, no independent or hands-on corroboration of the local workflow.
